subject: Security platform coverage & gap analysis for vendor shortlist
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:32:00 +0000
Subject: Security platform coverage & gap analysis for vendor shortlist

Team — attaching the consolidated gap matrix from the vendor demos last week and a rough pricing workbook that Sales pulled together. Key asks:

- Please review the matrix and highlight any missing controls that would block Dedicated or Private deployments (especially data retention/audit log capabilities).
- Confirm which items we consider "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" for SRE/infra and Legal.
- If you see obvious lane where TrustCenter vs Vanta tradeoffs are decisive, call it out (eg. SSO/SCIM, evidence export, audit-log retention).

I put a short summary row for each vendor at the top of the matrix. My read: Vanta is simpler to operate but has larger evidence-gathering gaps for our infra automation; TrustCenter has stronger marketplace/workflow integrations but pricing is higher and their SOC2 export UX is rough.

Attachments: platform_feature_gap_matrix.csv, vanta_pricing_q2_2027.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Procurement & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0194

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Security platform coverage & gap analysis for vendor shortlist

Thanks — quick notes after scanning the matrix:

- Evidence export: must-have. We need bulk exports (CSV or API) with hashed PII preserved for audits. Marked as blocker for Vanta unless they commit to a delivery timeline.
- Audit log retention: we require 2 years of immutable logs for Private builds; TrustCenter shows support but we need exact SLA.
- SCIM provisioning: nice-to-have but very valuable for scaling SRE onboarding automation.

I'll reach out to Legal to confirm the retention threshold that triggers an exemption. Vivek — can you validate the artifact types we need (KV cache proofs, infra runbooks, config drift snapshots)? If those aren't captured by either vendor out-of-the-box, we have to add an integration sprint in the SOW.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@vanta.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vanta - initial answers for Redwood (pricing + exports)

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@vanta.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:58:21 -0700
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Subject: Vanta - initial answers for Redwood (pricing + exports)

Hi Monica — thanks for the conversation earlier. I’m attaching the pricing workbook and a short note on the evidence export options we have in Q2. Quick summary:

- Export: We can provide an S3-batched export of evidence within 30 days with a standardized schema. For immutable/audit-preserved logs we can deliver object-lock compatible exports to your S3 if you opt for the Enterprise plan.
- SCIM: Available in Enterprise; provisioning rate limits will need coordination for large org syncs.
- Integrations: We have a small API for ingesting infra artifacts; we’ll commit to a 30-day integration pilot to map Redwood artifacts if you choose to proceed.
- Pricing: Enterprise tier with the exports/integrations runs ~65K/year; we can offer a 10% first-year discount if you commit by May 15.

Attachments: vanta_pricing_q2_2027.xlsx

Let me know if you want a quick follow-up demo to walk through the export format.

Best,
Jordan Smith
Enterprise Sales, Vanta
jordan.smith@vanta.com | +1 617-555-0284

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@vanta.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@trustcenter.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vanta - initial answers for Redwood (pricing + exports)

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround and the workbook. A couple of clarification requests before we escalate to Procurement for a term sheet:

1) Can you confirm the exact JSON schema or CSV columns for the S3-batched evidence export? Our infra team needs field-level names to script validation.
2) For the S3 object-lock option: is that an add-on or part of Enterprise? If add-on, provide SKU and delta vs the quoted 65K price.
3) Pilot scope: the 30-day integration pilot — what are the acceptance criteria? We’ll want a short mutual action plan (MAP) including artifact types, sample files, and timeline.

If you can send that detail by EOD Fri (US), we’ll schedule a short sync with Legal/Procurement next week to review the draft SOW and pricing.

Laura / Vivek / Marissa — please add any missing must-have items in the matrix and flag anything that would require a separate engineering effort (approx dev weeks).

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Procurement & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
